-# Hello-World
### [Codertocat published a security advisory: Path traversal in the static file handler](https://github.com/Codertocat/Hello-World/security/advisories/GHSA-4f7x-2q9m-8c3p)

**Impact**
A crafted request path lets an attacker read files outside of the public directory.
**Patches**
Upgrade to 1.4.2.
